name: Red Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from Red Herb. Recovers about 45 HP.

name: Orange Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from Red Herb and Yellow Herb. Recovers about 105 HP.

name: Yellow Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from Yellow Herb. Recovers about 175 HP.

name: Holy Water
description: Blessed water used for sacred rites. Cures Curse.

name: Carrot Juice
description: Carrot juice stored in a bottle. Easier to drink and restores better than eating the vegetable itself.

name: Pet Food
description: Food made from ingredients loved by pets. Clean and tasty enough for humans to eat. Most pets enjoy this food.

name: Raw Fish
description: Processed fish meat containing the freshness of the sea. Said to create a whirlwind of flavor the moment it touches the tongue.

name: Red Slim Potion
description: Same effect as Red Potion but much lighter.

name: White Slim Potion
description: Same effect as White Potion but much lighter.

name: Sushi
description: Dish from an eastern country, consisting of raw fish placed on rice mixed with vinegar. Tangy flavor blends well with the natural taste of the fish.

name: Mochi
description: Soft, warm, and deliciously made rice cake. Extremely smooth, so swallowing without care may cause it to stick in the throat.

name: Novice Potion
description: Special recovery item crafted in the Newbie Training Grounds for beginning Newbie adventurers. Recovers a small amount of HP.

name: Prickly Fruit
description: Spiky fruit with a refreshing scent. Recovers a small amount of HP and SP.

name: Grain
description: Edible crop with a mild flavor, easy to store and long preserved, making it a staple food. Recovers a small amount of HP.

name: Delicious Fish
description: Fish used in various dishes depending on cooking method. Often categorized into white meat and blue-backed fish. Recovers a small amount of HP.

name: Bread
description: Bread baked to an appealing color with a pleasant aroma. Recovers a small amount of HP.

name: Edible Mushroom
description: Mushrooms that vary widely in type and flavor. Used in cooking or eaten grilled. Recovers a small amount of HP.

name: Butterfly Wing
description: Enchanted fragment of a Butterfly Wing. Teleports the user to their saved location.

name: Yggdrasil Leaf
description: Leaf of Yggdrasil, holding powerful life energy. Can revive a character who is unable to fight.

name: Mini Furnace
description: Portable Furnace. Used for metal production. Disappears after one use.

name: Iron Hammer
description: Hammer made from Steel. Can be used to forge weapons. Disappears after one use.

name: Golden Hammer
description: Hammer made of gold. Can be used to forge weapons. Disappears after one use.

name: Oridecon Hammer
description: Hammer made from Oridecon. Can be used to forge weapons. Disappears after one use.

name: Orc Trophy
description: Symbol of strict organizational discipline. Monster Orc Warrior loves it. Event monsters and slave monsters cannot be tamed.

name: No Recipient
description: Old undelivered letter with an unknown recipient. Monster Munak loves it. Event monsters and slave monsters cannot be tamed.

name: Awakening Potion
description: Mysterious potion that induces an awakened state. Increases ASPD when consumed. Usable only by characters Lv.40 or higher, except Acolyte/Priest/Bard/Dancer.

name: Berserk Potion
description: Powerful potion that heats the blood and drives the user into a berserk state. Increases ASPD when consumed. Usable only by characters Lv.85 or higher belonging to Swordman Class/Rogue/Mage/Wizard/Merchant Class/Gunslinger Class.

name: Her Heart
description: Charm said to contain the feelings of an unknown girl. Monster Bongun likes it. Event monsters and slave monsters cannot be tamed.

name: Poison Bottle
description: Terrifying poison contained in a skull-shaped bottle. Anyone who drinks it will likely Suicide.

name: Empty Bottle
description: Empty bottle containing nothing. Seems suitable for filling and carrying something inside.

name: Garnet
description: Gemstone with a deep crimson hue.

name: 1 Carat Diamond
description: Gemstone that shines with a transparent, shimmering light.

name: Chung Jah
description: Ceramic piece with a calming blue sheen, said to be crafted by a famous artisan from a small eastern country.

name: Pencil Case
description: Holder used to store writing tools, suitable as a gift for students.

name: Rouge
description: Accessory rarely made for wealthy ladies to enhance their appearance, produced using animal fat or plants.

name: Poring Doll
description: Doll modeled after the fairly popular monster Poring.

name: Bouquet
description: Bundle of flowers tied together, often used to express love or gratitude. Said that there is hardly a woman who would dislike receiving this.

name: Wedding Bouquet
description: Small Bouquet carried by brides at weddings. A distant country’s legend says that the woman who catches it will be the next to marry.

name: Baphomet Doll
description: Doll modeled after a mountain goat, created as a side project during a doll maker’s experimental work.

name: Osiris Doll
description: Doll modeled after Mummy, created as a side project during a doll maker’s experimental work.

name: Archaeologist's Research Journal
description: Research journal lost by Archeologist.

name: Expedition Token
description: Emblem proving membership in the royal investigation unit, crafted as a portable necklace.

name: Familiar Sample
description: Sample collected for research on Familiar.

name: Thief Bug Sample
description: Sample collected for research on Thief Bug.

name: Ymir Heart Fragment
description: Ymir Heart Fragment once stored beneath Prontera Castle.

name: Shining Armor
description: Shining Armor crafted by a blacksmith at the request of Merchant. Designed more for display than battle—hopefully no one actually wears it into combat.

name: Counteragent
description: A mixture of chemical substances that can only be produced by the most intelligent individuals. Used for Hair Styling and Dye.

name: Mixture
description: A special compound that has applications that can only be understood by keen minds schooled in science. Used for Hair Styling and Dye.

name: Scarlet Dyestuffs
description: Red-colored dye that is made from ground red herbs.

name: Lemon Dyestuffs
description: Yellow-colored dye that is made from ground yellow herbs.

name: Cobaltblue Dyestuffs
description: Blue-colored dye that is made from ground blue herbs.

name: Darkgreen Dyestuffs
description: Green-colored dye that is made out of ground green herbs.

name: Orange Dyestuffs
description: Orange-colored dye that is made from a mixture of ground red and yellow herbs.

name: Violet Dyestuffs
description: Purple-colored dye that is made from a mixture of ground blue and red herbs.

name: White Dyestuffs
description: White-colored dye that is made out of ground white herbs..

name: Anvil
description: A smithing tool on which heated metals are placed so that they can be shaped by hammering. This is required when crafting weapons.

name: Oridecon Anvil
description: A smithing tool made from pure oridecon on which heated metals are placed so that they can be shaped by hammering. This is required when crafting weapons.

name: Golden Anvil
description: A smithing tool made from pure gold on which heated metals are placed so that they can be shaped by hammering. This is required when crafting weapons.

name: Tiger Skin
description: A tiger's hide that's soft, furry, nice and feral. Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Morroc Solution
description: A test tube that contains Morocc solution.

name: Payon Solution
description: A test tube that contains Payon solution.

name: Empty Test Tube
description: An empty test tube that can be used to contain some kind of solution.

name: Empty Potion Bottle
description: An empty bottle that can be used to contain potions.

name: Clothing Dye Coupon
description: A coupon that lets you dye Clothes. <NAVI>[Stylist]<INFO>itemmall,19,71,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>

name: Clothing Dye Coupon II
description: A coupon that lets you restore Clothes to their original color. <NAVI>[Stylist]<INFO>itemmall,19,71,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>

name: Makeover Brush
description: A brush capable of drawing small, delicate patterns. Used exclusively for Body Painting.

name: Paint Brush
description: Wide-bristled brush with a long handle, used exclusively for Ground Graffiti.

name: Wolf Flute
description: Very small whistle producing a sound audible only to wolves tamed by Rangers.

name: Eden Group Mark
description: Badge proving membership in the Eden Group. Designed for convenient carrying.

name: Carnium
description: One of the hardest metals on the continent of Midgard. It has exceptional strength, but its extreme hardness makes it difficult to refine. It can refine Lv. 1 armor with a refine level of +10 or higher. (If refining fails, the equipment's refine level may decrease by 3 or the equipment may break.)

name: Bradium
description: One of the hardest metals found in Aeshvakhum. It was too hard to refine, but after continued research, weapon refinement has recently become possible. It can refine Lv. 1~4 weapons with a refine level of +10 or higher. (If refining fails, the equipment's refine level may decrease by 3 or the equipment may break.)

name: [Event] Token of Siegfried
description: Emblem imbued with the energy of Acoustic Rhythm. Said to allow the bearer to overcome death. Upon death, consumes the item to revive immediately at the place of death.

name: Bulk Buyer Shop License
description: Permit issued by the Merchant Guild for a purchase-only street stall. Stamped with the Merchant Guild’s seal. (Single-use)

name: Field Shovel
description: Tool originally used for digging soil. Rumored to also serve for cooking ramen, frying eggs, or scooping rice.

name: Blacksmith Blessing
description: Desperate wishes of every blacksmith in this world are contained within this bottle. Negates refinement level decrease or equipment destruction once upon failure, and disappears after granting its blessing regardless of success or failure. Required amount increases based on refinement level. ※ Required quantity for refinement +7 -> +8 : 1 +8 -> +9 : 2 +9 -> +10 : 4 +10 -> +11 : 7 +11 -> +12 : 11 +12 -> +13 : 16 +13 -> +14 : 22 ※ Applies only up to refinement attempt +14.

description: Stone imbued with intelligence. Grants the following effect when slotted into a Upper costume slot. INT +1. <NAVI>[Costume Enchant Master]<INFO>itemmall,41,54,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>

name: HIT Stone (Lower)
description: Stone that enhances accuracy. Grants the following effect to the costume Lower slot. HIT +1.

name: FLEE Stone (Lower)
description: Stone that enhances evasion. Grants the following effect to the costume Lower slot. FLEE +1.

name: Ghost Free Charm
description: Souls of children who met an unfortunate end are bound to a single sheet of paper and forced into slumber.

name: Jeremy's Beauty Coupon
description: Styling Shop exclusive Beauty Coupon I. Allows selection of a new hairstyle.

name: CRI Stone (Upper)
description: Stone that increases critical hit chance. Grants the following effect to the costume Upper slot. CRIT +1.

name: MaxHP Stone (Middle)
description: Stone that increases physical endurance. Grants the following effect to the costume Middle slot. MaxHP +50.

name: MaxSP Stone (Lower)
description: A stone that increases SP power. Grants the following effect to the costume Lower slot. MaxSP +10.

name: Status Reset Ticket
description: Status Reset Ticket usable for up to three retries within one hour. Allows the user to reset their status points. All carts and summons must be dismissed. <NAVI>[Mystic Jester]<INFO>itemmall,35,63,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>

name: Old Stat Reset Ticket
description: Used Status Reset Ticket. Deleted if more than one hour has passed since use, or if all three reset attempts within the hour have been consumed. Also deleted when attempting to use it while its valid time has expired, and further status resets become unavailable. All carts and summons must be dismissed. <NAVI>[Mystic Jester]<INFO>itemmall,35,63,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>

name: Recovery Stone (Upper)
description: Stone infused with Heal effect. Grants the following effect when slotted into a Upper costume: Heal and item-based HP recovery +2%.

name: Recovery Skill Stone (Upper)
description: A stone which increases skill recovery amount. Grants the following effect when slotted into a Upper costume: Recovery-type skill Heal effect +3%.

name: Recovery Stone (Middle)
description: A stone with recovery power. Grants the following effect when slotted into a Middle costume: Recovers 10 HP every 10 seconds.

name: HP Stone (Middle)
description: A stone that increases health. Grants the following effect when slotted into a Middle costume: MaxHP +1%.

name: SP Stone (Middle)
description: Stone that increases magical capacity. Grants the following effect when slotted into a Middle costume: MaxSP +1%.

name: Large Stone (Upper)
description: Stone effective against large enemies. Grants the following effect when slotted into a Upper costume: Damage to Large Monsters +1%.

name: Medium Stone (Upper)
description: Stone effective against medium-sized enemies. Grants the following effect when slotted into a Upper costume: Damage to Medium Monsters +1%.

name: Small Stone (Upper)
description: Stone effective against small enemies. Grants the following effect when slotted into a Upper costume: Damage to Small Monsters +1%.

description: Stone that increases maximum HP. Grants the following effect when slotted into a Lower costume: MaxHP +1%.

name: Tough Scalelike Stem
description: Far tougher and more durable scale stem. Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Old_Hilt
description: Old and worn sword hilt that still carries deep dignity. The blade is missing, leaving only the hilt.

name: Bloody Edge
description: A blade stained with blood that can't be cleansed.

name: Matchstick
description: Stick coated with an easily flammable substance, capable of producing fire through friction.

name: Kafra Warp Free Ticket
description: Free pass that allows one complimentary use of Kafra Warp.

name: Kafra Cart Free Ticket
description: Free pass that allows one complimentary use of the Kafra Cart Service.

name: Freya's Jewel
description: Brilliant gem said to have formed from the tears of Goddess Freyja. Merely gazing upon it is enchanting.

name: Thor's Gauntlets
description: Steel gloves said to have been worn by Thor when he hurled his hammer. Sturdy and practical in appearance, yet cannot be worn.

name: Iron Maiden
description: Brutal torture device said to have been used on women in a distant era. Their screams seem to echo from within even now.

name: Wheel of the Unknown
description: Gear-shaped object with no identifiable purpose. It must serve some function, but no one knows what that might be.

name: Silver Ornament
description: Ornate decorations made of silver. Can be fitted onto various things to create stylish effects.

name: Wrath of Valkyrie
description: Masterpiece sculpture crafted by an artisan who depicted the wrathful visage of Valkyries gathering warriors.

name: Feather of Angel Wing
description: Feather said to have fallen from an angel. Its authenticity cannot be confirmed.

name: Cat Tread
description: Curious item said to contain the sound of a cat’s footsteps, gathered and condensed into a tangible form.

name: Woman's Moustache
description: Collection of beards supposedly plucked from women. Surely they must have been rather masculine.

name: Root of Stone
description: Root-like formation said to have existed since the dawn of stone. Worth digging up stones along the roadside to find it.

name: Spirit of Fish
description: Bottle sealed with the soul said to dwell within fish. Its faint, transparent blue glow is beautiful.

name: Sputum of Bird
description: Long, narrow bottle said to contain saliva shed by birds.

name: Sinew of Bear
description: Bundle of powerful Bear Tendon. Shows remarkably elastic form.

name: Emblem of the Sun God
description: Bead symbolizing the sun god, glowing with dazzling golden light.

name: Breath of Spirit
description: Breath said to be exhaled by wandering souls. Touching it chills the living to the bone.

name: Snow Crystal
description: Large crystal formed from accumulated falling snow. Ice Crystal, always hexagonal, brings a sense of warmth to those who gaze upon it.

name: Omen of Tempest
description: Bottle containing an image foretelling an approaching, powerful storm.

name: Ripple
description: Bottle capturing the image of gentle waves brushing against the feet on a clear day at the seaside.

name: Billow
description: Sculpture depicting the rough waves crashing against the coast on a windy day.

name: Drifting Air
description: Crafted by an artisan inspired by air that moves unseen yet never ceases.

name: Live Coal
description: Ember not fully extinguished, faintly glowing red as it clings to the last of its oxygen.

name: Bacillus
description: Tissue forming the body of mushrooms or molds.

name: Dragon Skin
description: Piece cut from beneath Dragon Scale after removing the scale itself.

name: Scorpion Claw
description: Exceptionally sharp Scorpion Claw, gleaming with a slick sheen.

name: Alcohol Creation Guide
description: Book describing methods for producing alcohol.

name: Bottle Grenade Creation Guide
description: Book detailing how to create Bottle Grenade. Not recommended for use in demonstrations.

name: Acid Bottle Creation Guide
description: Book explaining how to manufacture Acid Bottle. Hydrochloric acid is highly corrosive, so handle with care.

name: Plant Bottle Creation Guide
description: Book describing how to create a bottle containing carnivorous plants. These are not simple insectivores—handle with caution.

name: Marine Sphere Creation Guide
description: Book outlining the process of crafting naval mines. A mine is a bomb that floats in air or water and detonates on contact. Use extreme caution when making them.

name: Glistening Coat Creation Guide
description: Book recording how to produce Coating Agent. Applying the coating leaves a glossy, polished finish.

name: Slim Potion Creation Guide
description: Book describing how to brew slim potions. Contains knowledge to create potions enjoyed by many users.

name: Medicine Bowl
description: Mortar Bowl used to finely grind herbs. Made of porcelain and polished to a white shine.

name: Seed of Life
description: Extraordinary seed radiating abundant vitality even at a glance.

name: Yggdrasil Morning Dew
description: Dawn dew gathered upon Yggdrasil Berry.

name: Embryo
description: Embryonic form of some unknown being.

name: Glass Tube
description: Capable of sustaining life even for someone near death, and able to nurture embryos placed inside.

name: Potion Creation Guide
description: Manual describing the method for producing standard potions.

name: Tuxedo
description: Men’s wedding suit with a clean, elegant design. Some tease its wearer by calling him a penguin.

name: Gold Bullion
description: Block of pure gold refined from countless ore pieces. Highly malleable and ductile, making it a widely used form of currency.

name: Silver Bullion
description: Block of pure silver refined from numerous ore pieces. Valued for its malleability and pale sheen, often used as currency.

name: Platinum Bullion
description: Block of platinum polished into a clean square. Rarer than gold and possessing several times its value.

name: Agate
description: Mineral found in spherical or oval shapes, with names varying by color and pattern. Beautiful ones are used as gemstones. Protection and stability.

name: Muscovite
description: Mineral with perfect scale-like crystals, often called White Stone Scales. Its glossy surface symbolizes renewed motivation.

name: Turquoise
description: Well-known decorative stone with a glossy pale-blue or sky-blue hue. Signifies mental command.

name: Biotite
description: Most common form of mica, resembling dark scales. Mental support.

name: Free Ticket for Peco Ride
description: Allows one free use of Peco Peco.

name: Several Books
description: Collection of Bundle of Books. Quite heavy.

name: Leather Pouch
description: Sturdy-looking Leather Pouch containing a few items.

name: Empty Scroll
description: Blank scroll developed at the Juno Magic Academy for storing unwritten magic formulas.

name: Elemental Potion Creation Guide
description: Cover reads: 'Even a Poring becomes an Elemental Potion Master with this!' A book that clearly explains how to craft elemental potions. - Author: Peace Leak Cube.

name: Yellow Spice
description: Yellow powder with a unique aroma that enhances the flavor of food.

name: Sweet Sauce
description: Sweet, intensely flavored liquid that enhances the taste of dishes. Drinking it straight feels like it could melt your tongue.

name: Plain Sauce
description: Savory sauce that adds a clean, mild flavor to cooking.

name: Hot Sauce
description: A fiercely spicy sauce whose aroma alone can bring tears. Said to create the flavor of a 'fiery man.'

name: Red Spice
description: Red powder with a sharp, zesty aroma that enriches the flavor of food.

name: Cooking Oil
description: Edible oil that adds a glossy finish and a nutty fragrance to dishes. Some even drink it as is.

name: Lv.1 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'Never panic when you're alone. With this, you can survive anywhere.' Contains all Lv.1 cooking recipes.

name: Lv.2 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'A mother's touch that heals even the heart. For those who long for the warmth of family.' Contains all Lv.2 cooking recipes.

name: Lv.3 Cookbook
description: A Rune-Midgard bestseller for novice housewives! Don't miss this chance! Hugely popular among family-oriented husbands. Cover message leaves a strong impression. Contains all Lv.3 cooking recipes.

name: Lv.4 Cookbook
description: A touching cooking story no one can resist. Cover reads: 'You are already eating.' Contains all Lv.4 cooking recipes.

name: Lv.5 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'Reborn as a true chef. Challenge yourself toward the Spoon of God!' Contains all Lv.5 cooking recipes.

name: Lv.8 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'A lone chef now wanders across Rune-Midgard...!! — An epic tale of culinary inspiration —' Contains all Lv.8 cooking recipes.

name: Lv.10 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'First woman in the history of Prontera Kingdom to rise as the Royal Master Chef!! — Includes the author's autograph.' Contains all Lv.10 cooking recipes.

name: Pot
description: Cooking utensil used to prepare food. Different tools are used depending on the dish.

name: Old Heart Piece
description: Fragment of a heart removed during preparation of a Mummy to preserve the body for a long time.

name: Concentrated Elunium
description: A dense Elunium metal that has been condensed deep underground over a long period of time. Increases the refining success rate of armor.

name: Concentrated Oridecon
description: A dense Oridecon metal that has been condensed deep underground over a long period of time. Increases the refining success rate of weapons.

name: Token of Siegfried
description: Emblem imbued with the energy of Acoustic Rhythm. Said to allow the bearer to overcome death. Upon death, consumes the item to revive immediately at the place of death.

name: New Style Coupon
description: Perfect for those seeking a unique hairstyle! An item for anyone who wants something distinct from everyone else. <NAVI>[Stylist]<INFO>itemmall,19,71,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>

name: War Badge
description: Mark signifying participation in battle. Taken from the clothing of someone defeated in combat.

name: [Event] Blue Potion 10ea Box
description: Box containing 10 [Event] Blue Potion. Convenient for taking out as needed.

name: Skull Helm
description: Helm carved from an animal skull. Crude design, but overflowing with a primitive atmosphere. Equipped : Baphomet Jr.

name: Monster Oxygen Mask
description: Mask made so that even small pets can use it. Helps keep pets healthy. Equipped : Chonchon, Steel Chonchon, Hunter Fly

name: Wild Flower
description: Flower that bloomed alone in the wild without anyone’s help. Equipped : Orc Warrior

name: Stellar Hairpin
description: Star-shaped hairpin. Equipped : Green Petite

name: Poring Pet Backpack
description: Bag for carrying various things. Mainly designed for books, so it is called School Backpack. Equipped : Poring Drops Poporing

name: Rocker Glasses
description: Strange pair of glasses that somehow make the wearer look less kind and rather sly. Equipped : Rocker

name: Novice Combination Book
description: Too easy! Even Yoyo… no, even Fabre could do it! Just follow this book like a 1-minute cooking guide and you will get the result exactly as written. Caution: To begin a combination, you must [Double Click] the item “Combination Kit”. Caution: You must carry all required combination materials for the item you wish to create.

name: Novice Blue Potion
description: Blue Herb finely ground into a special mental recovery tonic for Newbie. Recovers about 5 SP.

name: Savory Herb Salad
description: Fragrant herb dish mixed with a refreshing sauce. Surprisingly energizing when eaten. STR +1 for 3 minutes. Recovers about 25 HP.

name: Apple Carrot Salad
description: Crisp harmony of apples and carrots! A crunchy salad that lifts your mood. AGI +1 for 3 minutes. Recovers about 25 HP.

name: Casual Stew
description: A stew made by tossing in whatever the cook felt like adding. VIT +1 for 3 minutes. Recovers about 25 HP.

name: Golden Roasted Apple
description: Whole roasted apple dripping with golden juice that makes your mouth water. DEX +1 for 3 minutes. Recovers about 25 HP.

name: [NFS] White Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from White Herb. Recovers about 325 HP.

name: [NFS] Yellow Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from Yellow Herb. Recovers about 175 HP.

name: Novice Red Potion
description: Special recovery tonic crafted just for Newbie beginning their adventure! Recovers a small amount of HP.

name: [NFS] Orange Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from Red Herb and Yellow Herb. Recovers about 105 HP.

name: [NFS] Red Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from Red Herb. Recovers about 45 HP.

name: [NFS] Green Potion
description: Healing tonic finely ground from Green Herb. Cures Poison, Silence, Blind, and Confusion.

name: [NFS] Blue Potion
description: Mental recovery tonic finely ground from Blue Herb. Recovers about 60 SP.

name: [NFS] Candy Cane
description: Lollipop-shaped candy. Recovers about 105 HP.

name: [NFS] Candy
description: Sweet, tasty candy. Recovers about 45 HP.

name: Fresh Milk
description: Freshly Squeezed Milk. Commonly used as a nutritious drink for growing children. Recovers a small amount of HP.

name: Raw Sweet Potato
description: Freshly harvested purple tuber. Rich in starch and sweet, often used as food. Recovers a small amount of HP.

name: Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 Arrow.

name: Iron Arrow Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 Iron Arrow.

name: Steel Arrow Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 Steel Arrow.

name: Oridecon Arrow Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 Oridecon Arrow.

name: Fire Arrow Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 Fire Arrow.

name: Silver Arrow Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 Silver Arrow.

name: Wind Arrow Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 Wind Arrow.

name: Stone Arrow Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 stone Arrow.

name: Shadow Arrow Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 Shadow Arrow.

name: Immaterial Arrow Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 Immaterial Arrow.

name: Rusty Arrow Quiver
description: Arrow Quiver containing 500 Rusty Arrow.

name: Cursed Water
description: Water tainted with a dark Curse, shrouded in a violet gloom. Using it grants the user’s weapon the 'Dark' property for 20 minutes.

name: Pork
description: Pork belly with beautiful triple layers of fat and meat. Absolutely delicious~♬

name: Galbi
description: Ribs always taste better grilled over charcoal~♬

name: Giggling Box
description: 30% chance to inflict Curse for 30 seconds. Recovers 9% HP.

name: Box of Grudge
description: Attack increases by 20 for 60 seconds.

name: Box of Storm
description: Imbues the weapon with the Water-Property for 3 minutes.

name: Box of Panting
description: 30% chance to inflict Silence for 30 seconds. Recovers 9% SP.

name: Stone of Sage
description: A legendary stone said to possess mystical alchemical power capable of turning base metals into gold. Warm and smooth with a red glow.

name: Fried Grasshopper
description: A simple dish even a Newbie can prepare. Tastes like fresh grass from an open field. STR +1.

name: Flipper Salad
description: A rare dish that may look unappealing at first, but opens the door to a whole new world once tasted. STR +2.

name: Bomber Steak
description: Looks like an ordinary steak, yet delivers an explosive burst of flavor the moment it's eaten. STR +3.

name: Herb Marinade Beef
description: Marinated ribs enhanced with herbs, using a cooking technique passed down in Payon for added aroma. STR +4.

name: Lutie Lady's Pancake
description: A sweet pancake crafted with the delicate touch of the Lady from Lutie. A taste that lifts the spirit. STR +5.

name: Grape Juice Herbal Tea
description: A refreshing tea infused with grape essence and herbal aroma. Clears the mind—though it may simply taste like grape juice. INT +1.

name: Autumn Red Tea
description: A tea blending three types of herbs to create a rich and harmonious fragrance. The taste itself is merely adequate. INT +2.

name: Honey Herbal Tea
description: Herbal tea sweetened with honey for extra comfort. Handle with care—it’s served hot. INT +3.

name: Morrcc Fruit Wine
description: A fruit wine crafted by a Merchant from Morroc using tangy fruits. Light and enjoyable even for those unaccustomed to alcohol. INT +4.

name: Mastela Fruit Wine
description: A distilled drink made from Mastela fruit refined solely for mental clarity. Best enjoyed in moderation. INT +5.

name: Steamed Crab
description: A simple dish of herbs boiled together with Claw Meat. Properly separating the shell is the key to enjoying it. VIT +1.

name: Assorted Seafood
description: A dish that evokes deep nostalgia for those born by the sea. Some say it brings tears to their eyes without warning. VIT +2.

name: Clam Soup
description: Shellfish boiled to preserve the full ocean flavor. Both the broth and the Shell Meat are meant to be enjoyed. VIT +3.

name: Seasoned Jellyfish
description: "Tentacle lightly cooked with squid ink and herbs. Looks delicious, yet the taste is unexpectedly subtle. VIT +4. --------------------------"

name: Spicy Fried Bao
description: Spicy grilled dumplings with a stimulating aroma. Eating too many may lead to regret the next day. VIT +5.

name: Frog Egg Squid Ink Soup
description: A soup made by gently boiling frog eggs. Best consumed in one swift bite with your eyes closed. AGI +1.

name: Smooth Noodle
description: Noodles with silky strands crafted by a master, so smooth they are almost difficult to eat. AGI +2.

name: Tentacle Cheese Gratin
description: Gratin made by stuffing slippery Tentacle with sweet Sweet Potato and rich cheese, baked until golden. Its flavor seems slightly different from the well-known children’s snack. AGI +3.

name: Lutie Cold Noodle
description: Dish where chill and spiciness blend in a delicate balance, with pumpkin used as a distinctive garnish. AGI +4.

name: Steamed Bat Wing in Pumpkin
description: Nourishing dish made by wrapping the mysterious ingredient Red Bat Wing in Hinalle leaves, then simmering it inside a hollowed pumpkin. Has a rather peculiar taste. AGI +5.

name: Honey Grape Juice
description: Special Grape Juice made by blending Grape Juice with nutritious honey. Sweet and pleasantly tangy. DEX +1.

name: Chocolate Mousse Cake
description: Signature chocolate mousse cake highly praised by royal dessert chef “Charles d'Orléans”, with a smooth texture and sweet, bittersweet flavor. DEX +2.

name: Fruit Mix
description: Dessert made by cutting assorted fruits into bite-sized pieces and soaking them in syrup. Crisp texture is its greatest charm. DEX +3.

name: Cream Sandwich
description: Light sandwich made with freshly baked bread filled with minced meat and cream cheese. Feels perfect as a lunch option. DEX +4.

name: Green Salad
description: Salad of healthy vegetables tossed in a sweet Umbala-style dressing. Latest wellness menu trend in Prontera. DEX +5.

name: Fried Monkey Tails
description: Monkey tail lightly stir-fried and simply seasoned. Rumored to be an extremely popular snack to go with drinks. LUK +1.

name: Mixed Juice
description: Mixed Juice made by skillfully blending various fruit juices. Getting the ratio wrong may send you into a whole new world. LUK +2.

name: Fried Sweet Potato
description: Dish made by deep-frying Sweet Potato and then simmering it with syrup. Crispy and sweet, making it a very popular snack. LUK +3.

name: Steamed Ancient Lips
description: Fish dish made by steaming freshly caught fish together with Ancient Fish Lips, believed to be good for health, wrapped in fragrant leaves. Said to be more popular among men than women. LUK +4.

name: Fried Scorpion Tails
description: Dish made by stir-frying only the tastiest part, the Scorpion Tail. The hard shell is cracked to enjoy the tender flesh inside. Slightly poisonous, so eating too much is not good for the body. LUK +5.

name: Shiny Marinade Beef
description: Grilled beef dish so exquisite that those who have tried it bestowed upon it the title of “Shining”. STR +6.

name: Whole Roast
description: Large cut of meat grilled whole with spicy sauce. Said to be the ultimate dish for true meat lovers. STR +7.

name: Bearfoot Special
description: Dish counted among the greatest delicacies of Yongji Castle, said to be especially prized when made using the right sole. STR +8.

name: Tendon Satay
description: Top-quality tendons quickly grilled so the natural flavor of the ingredients remains intact. STR +9.

name: Steamed Tongue
description: Finest-grade dish that is soft and delicious, with the only drawback being its expensive ingredients. Said to have also come from Yongji Castle. STR +10.

name: Red Mushroom Wine
description: Wine made from aged grapes, yet said to taste completely different from regular wine. The secret is rumored to lie in the use of mushrooms. INT +6.

name: Special Royal Jelly Herbal Tea
description: Herbal tea sweetened with Royal Jelly and honey, known to aid mental recovery, though its aroma is often considered unpleasant. INT +7.

name: Royal Family Tea
description: A signature royal dessert by Charles d’Orléans, whose sweet aroma is said to drift beyond the castle walls during tea time. INT +8.

name: Tristan 12-Year
description: Premium liquor crafted to commemorate the coronation of Tristan III, with the 12-year vintage considered the finest. INT +9.

name: Dragon Breath Cocktail
description: Liquor with a fierce flavor said to let you feel a dragon’s breath from a single sip. Those who taste it claim they can never forget it. INT +10.

name: Awfully Bitter Bracer
description: Some say medicine becomes more effective as its unpleasant taste grows stronger, though such claims remain unverified. VIT +6.

name: Sumptuous Feast
description: A curious dish said to bring tears as vivid mountains and blue seas unfold in your mind after eating it. VIT +7.

name: Giant Burito
description: A massive wrap seemingly made oversized on purpose so it cannot be eaten in a single bite. The creator’s intention is unmistakable. VIT +8.

name: Ascending Dragon Soup
description: Spicy dish made with ‘dragon’ as its main ingredient; those who try it say it feels as though they start to ascend. VIT +9.

name: Immortal Stew
description: Though its appearance and smell are rather unsettling, eating it is said to instill a strange sense of immortality. VIT +10.

name: Chile Shrimp Gratin
description: Gratin combining chili heat with savory shrimp—yet it tastes more like a spicy shrimp dish than a gratin. AGI +6.

name: Steamed Alligator with Vegetable
description: A recommended Umbala dish of lightly roasted crocodile meat wrapped with vegetables and steamed. Rumor says it is reserved for honored guests and cherished livestock. AGI +7.

name: Incredibly Spicy Curry
description: A fiercely spicy curry said to contain the ‘taste of endurance’. The key element is a pumpkin that strangely feels like it was once worn as a hat. AGI +8.

name: Special Meat Stew
description: A specialty of the Dragon Castle region—slow-simmered assorted meats whose aroma spreads widely when the lid is opened. AGI +9.

name: Peach Cake
description: Refreshing cake made with Kunlun’s specialty peaches, known for their incredibly soft texture and fragrant taste. DEX +6.

name: Soul Haunted Bread
description: Sweet bread so intense that some say it feels as though one’s soul might fly away; others claim their tongue nearly melts. DEX +7.

name: Special Toast
description: Massive toast filled with meat, fruit, and cheese—about three times the usual amount. Despite the abundance, the taste remains uncertain. DEX +8.

name: Heavenly Fruit Juice
description: A juice described by every taster as giving the sensation of ‘soaring into the sky’. Proper fruit balance is said to be crucial. DEX +9.

name: Hwergelmir's Tonic
description: Liquor so revered that it was named after a legendary spring—the very source of all rivers. Everyone who tried it praised it endlessly. DEX +10.

name: Lucky Soup
description: Dish said to bring extraordinary fortune only when eaten while fiercely hot. Then again… it may just be a rumor. LUK +6.

name: Assorted Shish Kebob
description: Skewered dish made by grilling long, thin cuts of assorted meats. Popular for letting diners choose ingredients to suit their taste. LUK +7.

name: Strawberry Flavored Rice Ball
description: Rice ball with the refreshing flavor and aroma of strawberries. A rare experience that feels like eating strawberries as a side dish. LUK +8.

name: Blood Flavored Soda
description: Carbonated soda loved by children for its sharp, fizzy taste. Slight hint of metallic flavor… but still enjoyable enough to overlook. LUK +9.

name: Cooked Nine Tail's Tails
description: Payon specialty cuisine made from the tail of Nine Tail, widely regarded across Rune-Midgarts as a dish of good fortune. LUK +10.

name: Tropical Sograt
description: Sweet yet strong alcoholic drink made by aging assorted fruits, famous in Morroc. Said to reach its best flavor when matured in the desert climate.

name: Elemental Converter (Fire)
description: Applying this grants the user's weapon the Fire-property for 20 minutes.

name: Elemental Converter (Water)
description: Applying this grants the user's weapon the Water-property for 20 minutes.

name: Elemental Converter (Earth)
description: Applying this grants the user's weapon the Earth-property for 20 minutes.

name: Elemental Converter (Wind)
description: Applying this grants the user's weapon the Wind-property for 20 minutes.

name: Fireproof Potion
description: Potion that increases resistance to Fire-property. Be careful, as it also increases damage taken from its opposing element.

name: Coldproof Potion
description: Potion that increases resistance to Water-property. Be careful, as it also increases damage taken from its opposing element.

name: Earthproof Potion
description: Potion that increases resistance to Earth-property. Be careful, as it also increases damage taken from its opposing element.

name: Thunderproof Potion
description: Potion that increases resistance to Wind-property. Be careful, as it also increases damage taken from its opposing element.

name: Outdoor Cooking Kit
description: A compact set of simple outdoor cooking tools. Looks like something used in survival cooking.

name: Home Cooking Kit
description: A collection of common household cooking utensils. Feels like it could recreate the taste of Mother.

name: Holy Arrow Quiver
description: Quiver filled with 500 Holy Arrow blessed with Holy Water.

name: Salty Rice Cake
description: Rice cake seasoned with a light salty flavor. Recovers a small amount of HP and SP.

name: Life Insurance
description: A certificate for short-term life insurance. Best used before dangerous combat. For 30 minutes after use, no EXP is lost on death. The effect ends after one death.

name: Bubble Gum
description: Chewy, sweet Bubble Gum. Chewing it somehow gives others the urge to hand over everything they have. Increases item drop rate from monsters by 100% for 30 minutes.

name: Lv.10 Blessing Scroll
description: Scroll inscribed with instructions for using Blessing Lv.10. Allows use of Blessing Lv.10. Warning! – Does not activate if used during casting.

name: Lv.10 Increase AGI Scroll
description: Scroll inscribed with instructions for using Increase Agility Lv.10. Allows use of Increase Agility Lv.10. Warning! – Does not activate if used during casting. Warning! – Consumes 15 HP. If HP is below 15, the effect will not activate and the scroll will be lost.

name: Lv.5 Aspersio Scroll
description: Scroll inscribed with instructions for using Aspersio Lv.5. Allows use of Aspersio Lv.5. Warning! – Does not activate if used during casting. Warning! – Scroll breaks if Holy Water is not available.

name: Megaphone
description: Mysterious horn-shaped device. Speaking into it broadcasts your message across the entire server. Warning – If nothing is entered for 3 minutes after use, the effect does not activate.

name: Novice Fly Wing
description: Wing pieces taken from birds and enchanted. Allows teleporting to a random location on the map.

name: Novice Butterfly Wing
description: Enchanted fragment of a Butterfly Wing. Teleports the user to their saved location.

name: Novice Magnifier
description: Magnifier. Enables closer inspection of objects for identification. Can also identify with [Ctrl + Right-click].

name: 1st Class Pork Belly
description: Top-grade pork. Simply delicious~♬

name: Thick Pork Belly
description: Pork belly said to bring people closer together. Great for sharing with family.

name: [Event] Bubble Gum
description: Chewy and sweet Bubble Gum. Anyone chewing this gum somehow gives others the feeling that they should hand over everything they have. For 30 minutes, increases the chance of monsters dropping items by 100%. Weight: 1

name: [Event] Small Life Potion
description: [Event] This item was distributed as part of an event. Small vial filled with sap from the Yggdrasil tree. Known for aiding wound recovery. Restores 5% of MHP every 5 seconds for 10 minutes. Effect does not activate during Frenzy. Effect ends if the character becomes incapacitated. Cannot be used in WoE Herosria.

name: Black Market Bulk Buyer Shop License
description: Certificate granting permission to open a purchasing store. The Merchant Guild’s seal looks oddly hand-drawn. (Single-use)

name: Halter Lead
description: A mystical bridle that allows any job class to ride a mount suited to them. Each class branch has its own mount type, and it changes accordingly upon transcending or advancing. Cannot be placed in Kafra Storage!

name: WoE Violet Potion 200ea Box
description: A box containing 200 WoE Violet Potion. (*Note* No effect in WoE, PvP, or non-town fields.)

name: Character Name Change Coupon
description: A card that allows the character’s name to be changed. Only the character who uses it may change their name, so use with care. ※ You must leave any party or guild before using this item.

name: Falcon Flute
description: A whistle that emits a special sound heard only by falcons trained by skilled hunters.

name: Combination Kit
description: Kit containing various tools for combining or converting different items in many ways. For some reason, even cooking utensils are included.

name: Unlimited Fly Wing
description: Rental Item Enchanted wing plucked from a bird, allowing warp to a random place on the map. Allows warping to a random location on the map.

name: Token of Siegfried 10ea Box
description: Box containing 10 Token of Siegfried. Token of Siegfried - Allows immediate resurrection at the place of death.

name: Bubble Gum 5ea Box
description: Box containing 5 fragrant, chewy pieces of Bubble Gum. Bubble Gum - For 30 minutes, increases monster item drop rate by 100%.

name: Small Life Potion 10ea Box
description: Box containing 10 Small Life Potion. Upon use, recovers 5% of MHP every 5 seconds for 10 minutes.

name: Small Life Potion 30ea Box
description: A box containing 30 Small Life Potion. Recovers 5% of MHP every 5 seconds for 10 minutes upon use.

name: Small Life Potion
description: A small vial filled with sap from the Yggdrasil tree, said to promote wound recovery. Recovers 5% of MHP every 5 seconds for 10 minutes upon use. Effect does not activate while under Frenzy. Effect is removed if the character becomes incapacitated.

name: [Scroll] Small Life Potion
description: A small vial filled with sap from the Yggdrasil tree, said to promote wound recovery. Recovers 5% of MHP every 5 seconds for 10 minutes upon use. Effect does not activate while under Frenzy. Effect is removed if the character becomes incapacitated.

name: Name Change Box
description: Box containing one card that allows changing a character’s name. ※ This item can be used only after leaving any party or guild.

name: Zelstar 40ea Box
description: Box containing 40 Zelstone. Jellopy fragments dropped from monsters fossilized over tens of thousands of years under high pressure and heat. Includes [Fashion Stone] for purchasing costumes and [Special Toolbox] for drawing various useful consumables. Also usable for world transfer services, refining (mineral synthesis), and more.

name: Essential Package
description: [Usage Period] 30 days after item use [Applies To] Character that used the item EXP/item drop rate +10% for 30 days. Provides full recovery and buffs 3 times per day. Also grants World Teleport Ticket x30 as a one-time bonus when opened. An essential package useful for everyone! Provides Yggdrasil Dew x3 daily for full HP/SP recovery and buffs. [Blessing of Yggdrasil] For 1 hour, all base stats +7, ATK/MATK +30, HIT/FLEE +5. Consumes Yggdrasil Dew x1 or Zelstar x1. Warning! - Yggdrasil Staff cannot be used in Memorial Dungeons (MD).

name: Account EXP Buff Box
description: [Usage Period] 30 days after item use [Target] All characters on the server where the item is used Contains a potion that grants the following benefits to all characters on the server for 30 days: - +10% EXP - +10% Job EXP

name: Account Drop Rate Buff Box
description: [Usage Period] 30 days after item use [Target] All characters on the server where the item is used Contains a potion that grants the following benefit to all characters on the server for 30 days: - +10% Item Drop Rate

name: Account Death Penalty Buff Box
description: [Usage Period] 30 days after item use [Target] All characters on the server where the item is used Contains a potion that grants the following benefit to all characters on the server for 30 days: -70% Reduced Death Penalty

description: Box containing 4 Zelstone. Jellopy fragments dropped from monsters fossilized over tens of thousands of years under high pressure and heat. name: Tool Dealer Summon Bell Box
description: A box containing 1 Tool Dealer Summon Bell usable for 30 days. With this, Tool Dealer can be called anywhere to buy useful consumables or sell items being carried. Warning! - Tool Dealer Summon Bell cannot be used in Memorial Dungeons (MD).

name: Kafra Storage Bell Box
description: Box containing 1 Kafra Storage Bell usable for 30 days. Allows opening storage through Kafra Employee simply by ringing it anywhere.

name: Account Storage Expansion Buff Box
description: [Usage Period] 30 days after item use [Target] All characters on the server where the item is used Contains a potion that grants the following benefits to all characters on the server for 30 days: - +300 Storage Capacity - +300 Cat Hand Storage Capacity

name: Account Storage Expansion Buff Box - 7 Days
description: [Usage Period] 7 days after item use [Target] All characters on the server where the item is used Contains a potion that grants the following benefits to all characters on the server for 7 days: - +300 Storage Capacity - +300 Cat Hand Storage Capacity

name: Account Death Penalty Buff Box - 7 Days
description: [Usage Period] 7 days after item use [Target] All characters on the server where the item is used Contains a potion that grants the following benefit to all characters on the server for 7 days: -50% Reduced Death Penalty

name: Account Drop Rate Buff Box - 7 Days
description: [Usage Period] 7 days after item use [Target] All characters on the server where the item is used Contains a potion that grants the following benefit to all characters on the server for 7 days: - +10% Item Drop Rate

name: Account EXP Buff Box - 7 Days
description: [Usage Period] 7 days after item use [Target] All characters on the server where the item is used Contains a potion that grants the following benefits to all characters on the server for 7 days: - +10% EXP - +10% Job EXP

name: Essential Package - 7 Days
description: [Usage Period] 7 days after item use [Applies To] Character that used the item EXP/item drop rate +10% for 7 days. Provides full recovery and buffs 3 times per day. name: Eden Group Mark
description: Badge exclusively issued to Eden Group members. Designed to be easy to carry. Cooldown : 20 minutes

name: [NFS] Concentration Potion
description: Potion infused with ingredients that enhance focus. Increases ASPD when consumed. Usable by All Jobs.

name: [NFS] Berserk Potion
description: Powerful potion that heats the blood and drives the user into a berserk state. Increases ASPD when consumed. Usable only by characters Lv.85 or higher belonging to Swordsman Class/Rogue/Mage/Wizard/Merchant Class/Gunslinger Class.

name: [NFS] Awakening Potion
description: Mysterious potion that induces an awakened state. Increases ASPD when consumed. Usable only by characters Lv.40 or higher, except Acolyte/Priest/Bard/Dancer.

name: [NFS] Speed Potion
description: Potion that drastically increases movement speed for a short time.

name: STR Reduction Potion
description: Reduces STR by 1 and returns the point to the status pool. Cannot be used when STR is 1.

name: AGI Reduction Potion
description: Reduces AGI by 1 and returns the point to the status pool. Cannot be used when AGI is 1.

name: VIT Reduction Potion
description: Reduces VIT by 1 and returns the point to the status pool. Cannot be used when VIT is 1.

name: INT Reduction Potion
description: Reduces INT by 1 and returns the point to the status pool. Cannot be used when INT is 1.

name: DEX Reduction Potion
description: Reduces DEX by 1 and returns the point to the status pool. Cannot be used when DEX is 1.

name: LUK Reduction Potion
description: Reduces LUK by 1 and returns the point to the status pool. Cannot be used when LUK is 1.

name: Small Healing Potion
description: A small bottle filled with sap from the Yggdrasil tree. Said to aid wound recovery. When consumed, restores 5% of MHP every 5 seconds for 30 minutes. The effect does not activate while in Frenzy state. The item effect disappears if the character becomes incapacitated. Cannot be used during WoE, and the effect will not activate.

name: Old Money Pouch
description: Well-worn Old Money Pouch. Shaking it produces a faint jingling sound, though it likely contains little of value.

name: [Event] Small Mana Potion
description: Small vial filled with sap extracted from petals of the Yggdrasil tree, said to enhance mana recovery. Recovers 5% of MSP every 5 seconds for 10 minutes. Effect does not activate while under Frenzy. Effect is removed when the character becomes incapacitated. Cannot be used in Herosria Siege.

name: Yggdrasil Staff
description: Staff that summons the Guardian of the World Tree, who bestows the Blessing of Yggdrasil. [Service Details] Provides 3 World Tree Dew each day, up to a maximum of 3 including those already carried. Available once per day. - Blessing of Yggdrasil: Consumes 1 World Tree Dew or Zelstar to grant a 1-hour buff. All HP/SP are restored the moment the blessing is received. All Stats +7 ATK +30, MATK +30, HIT +5, FLEE +5. Warning! Buff is removed upon death. Warning! - Yggdrasil Staff cannot be used in Memorial Dungeons (MD).
